description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter creature token and gaining 1 life.
The Thopter token enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning it to the battlefield and attaching it to the Thopter token.
Repeat until you have 5 Thopters tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing 5 Thopter tokens, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
